      ComplyRight A1204 Details

      Organize your employee records with this ComplyRight expanded confidential personnel pocket file folder. This durable folder is made of manila cardstock for long-lasting, repeated use, and is designed to help make paperwork easier to file and retrieve. It is developed by attorneys for total compliance with employment recordkeeping and privacy laws. It also allows you to record basic employee information right on the folder for convenience.

      More sensitive documents can be stored in the inside pocket of the folder. The expandable spine extends to 1 1/4" for even more storage space. Plus, the extended tab helps employers to easily locate employee information for ultimate organization. Its 9 1/2" x 11 3/4" size ensures that it will easily fit in standard filing cabinets for quick access, and with 25 folders per pack, there is no need to worry about running out right away. It is the perfect solution for businesses looking to centralize their employee records.

      Overall Dimensions:
      Length: 11 3/4"
      Width: 9 1/2"
      Depth: 1 1/4"
